fields.acceptance: Unit tests in internal/run and internal/api (go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... ./internal/api/... -run for the run-tmp tests, e.g. gotmp_test.go and run_abandon_gotmp_test.go) show run.TmpDir resolves outside the repo's git common dir, a step sees {run_tmp} at that path with the folder present, and after the run ends or is abandoned only that run's folder is removed (never the shared run-tmp parent nor another run's folder); the {run_tmp} wording in internal/workflow/spec.go and the workflow-env docs names the new location
fields.statement: A run's {run_tmp} folder lies outside every git repository, at os.UserCacheDir()/rhiza/run-tmp/<run id> (or os.TempDir()/rhiza-run-tmp-<uid>/<run id> when there is no user cache dir), made as a step starts and removed when the run finishes, fails or is abandoned, so GOTMPDIR and anything else a workflow points at {run_tmp} never sits under the repo's git dir; existing workflows need no edit

fields.acceptance: A test in cmd/rhiza (go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run for it) calls the Setup check on a $WORK under a git work tree and under a .git dir and gets the error naming the path and GOTMPDIR, and on a $WORK outside any repo gets none; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/ci-install passes
fields.statement: cmd/rhiza's testscript Setup fails a script before it runs when its $WORK resolves inside a git work tree or a git dir, with an error naming the path and saying to set GOTMPDIR outside the repository, so no script can write into a real repo
